lost_passport.title: Lost passport
lost_passport.reassurance: Stay calm — this is recoverable. Most travelers receive emergency docs within 48–72 hours.
steps: File a police report (遺失届) at the nearest kōban or police station — keep the report number.
Contact your embassy/consulate with police report, passport photos, and travel itinerary.
Apply for Emergency Certificate (EC) or temporary passport for onward travel.
Notify your airline — some carriers require valid ID 24h before departure.

missed_train.title: Missed train / Shinkansen
missed_train.reassurance: Stay calm — Japan's rail network has frequent alternatives.
steps: Check if your ticket is flexible (reserved vs non-reserved) at the JR window.
Board the next available train — staff can often reseat you for a fee.
If last train missed, book capsule hotel or business hotel near station.
Use JapanTaxi or official taxi stand — avoid unlicensed solicitors.
contacts: Station master window at major hubs

medical_emergency.title: Medical emergency
medical_emergency.reassurance: Stay calm — call 119 for ambulance. Say your location clearly.
steps: Dial 119 — request ambulance (救急車 kyūkyūsha).
If conscious, go to nearest hospital ER with English desk (St. Luke's, Tokyo Adventist).
Bring passport and travel insurance card.
Contact insurer 24h helpline for cashless/direct billing if covered.
